description: This file defines the NameExpression class used in the Twig templating engine to handle variable name expressions within templates.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\NameExpression
classes.description: Represents a variable name expression in Twig templates, providing mechanisms to compile this expression into executable PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a NameExpression with a variable name and line number, triggers deprecation if used directly in new code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for variable access or checks based on the expression's attributes.

methods.name: isSpecial
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if the name is a special variable; will be removed in Twig 4.0.

methods.name: isSimple
methods.description: Deprecated method to determine if the expression is a simple variable; will be removed in Twig 4.0.
